tasks.completion_summary: Split proxy/server.go (3,082 lines) into 9 focused modules: server.go, proxy_handler.go, health.go, rewrite.go, files.go, ws_handler.go, ws_session.go, ws_broadcast.go, ws_parse.go

Split scripts/audit.js (3,528 lines) into 6 domain-focused modules: audit-utils.js (33 lines), audit-dom.js (594 lines), audit-css.js (571 lines), audit-security.js (794 lines), audit-performance.js (555 lines), audit-quality.js (1,040 lines). Updated embed.go with new declarations and loading order.

Consolidated dual-mode (daemon/legacy) tool pattern in get_errors.go and responsive_audit.go. Introduced backend structs that hold either DaemonTools or ProxyManager, unified registration into single RegisterXTool functions, extracted shared post-processing into formatErrorsOutput().

Added moduleEntry struct, moduleOrder slice with explicit deps, moduleScript map to embed.go. Refactored buildCombinedScript to iterate moduleOrder. Created embed_test.go with TestModuleDependencyOrder verifying deps appear before dependents and no orphaned embeds. Updated responsive_test.go and wireframe_test.go for new comment format.
